fullPassage: In both the arts and the sciences, an aesthetics of simplicity facilitates the precise communication of messages. Both are also fairly systematic. Although many people believe that art is by definition wild and intuitive, while only science is methodologically disciplined, there is a great deal of evidence — including from artists talking about their own practices — to suggest that art is often created methodically and systematically, and that frameworks and forms permit creativity to flow. Instead of being liberating, freedom without limits is almost paralysing, because without frameworks we end up in a vacuum in which our actions generate no response. As the Danish poet and filmmaker Jørgen Leth has put it many times, ‘the rules of the game’ are a prerequisite for artistic freedom. They provide a solid form or structure that enables the artist to make use of ‘the gifts of chance’ (to use Leth’s expression), and in which a part of the world can be exhibited in a non-chaotic manner. In order to create beauty, the artist must restrict him- or herself.

Although many people believe that art is by definition wild and intuitive, while only science is methodologically disciplined, there is a great deal of evidence — including from artists talking about their own practices — to suggest that art is often created methodically and systematically, and that frameworks and forms permit creativity to flow. Instead of being liberating, freedom without limits is almost paralysing, because without frameworks we end up in a vacuum in which our actions generate no response. As the Danish poet and filmmaker Jørgen Leth has put it many times, ‘the rules of the game’ are a prerequisite for artistic freedom. They provide a solid form or structure that <u>enables</u> the artist to make use of ‘the gifts of chance’ (to use Leth’s expression), and in which a part of the world can be exhibited in a non-chaotic manner. In order to create beauty, the artist must restrict him- or herself.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 enables와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: enables=가능하게 하다 → allows=허용하다/가능하게 하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① prevents: prevents(막다)는 enables(가능하게 하다)의 반의어
❌ ② permits: permits(허용하다)는 유사하지만 본문에 이미 등장하는 단어이므로 cross-leak 회피. allows가 더 정확한 동의어
✅ ③ allows: allows(허용하다/가능하게 하다)는 enables(가능하게 하다)의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ④ forces: forces(강제하다)는 가능하게 하는 것과 의미 방향이 다름
det.tip: enables = allows = 가능하게 하다, 할 수 있게 하다

questions.passage:
(A) The judge ordered the suspect to <u>restrict</u> his movements to the local area until the trial date.
(B) In order to create beauty, the artist must <u>restrict</u> him- or herself, choosing specific forms and frameworks rather than pursuing unlimited freedom.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 restrict의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: restrict: (A) 법적으로 행동 범위를 제한하다 / (B) 예술적 창작을 위해 스스로를 절제하고 자기규율하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 제한하다 — (B) 제한하다: (B)에서 restrict oneself는 단순한 제한이 아닌 의지적 절제/자기규율의 의미
✅ ② (A) 제한하다 — (B) 절제하다/자기규율하다: (A)는 판사가 외부적으로 행동을 제한, (B)는 예술가가 스스로 절제하여 창의성을 위한 틀을 만드는 자발적 자기규율 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 금지하다 — (B) 제한하다: (A)는 완전 금지가 아닌 범위 제한
❌ ④ (A) 구속하다 — (B) 포기하다: (A)는 구속이 아닌 이동 제한, (B)는 포기가 아닌 절제
det.tip: restrict: ① (외부적) 범위를 제한하다 ② (자발적) 스스로를 절제하다/규율하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "something that is required as a prior condition for something else to happen or exist"

❌ ③ evidence: evidence(증거)는 사전 조건이 아닌 주장을 뒷받침하는 자료

det.tip: prerequisite = 전제조건. 'the rules of the game' are a prerequisite for artistic freedom
